faq.title: Straight answers
faq.1q: What do you need from me?
faq.1a1: For The Complete Kit or a monthly plan: your business name, website or Instagram, email, city and industry. For a Brand Deck: the same details, plus your business address and the language you want the deck in. We then email you a payment link.
faq.1a2: It helps if you send your logo, your brand colors if you have them, and your own photos. Everything is built around your existing logo and approved assets, and we don't use stock photos of strangers in your posts.
faq.2a1: You do. The designs, captions and plans are files ready for you or your team to publish. Nothing is published for you.
faq.4q: Who owns what you make for me?
faq.4a1: The deck files, designs and captions we deliver to you are yours to use in your business. Your logo, name and brand stay yours, and we do not show work made for you in public without your written OK.
faq.5a1: No. Nobody can honestly promise that. We deliver the kit, the designs and the plans described on the pricing page. Results depend on your business, your market and what you do with them.
faq.7q: Which languages do you work in?
faq.7a1: This site is in English, Spanish, French and Arabic, and you can write to us in any of them. A Brand Deck can be made in English, Spanish, French or Arabic, or in Arabic and English together.
faq.9a1: We use them to prepare what you asked for and email you about it. You can ask us to export or delete them any time at {email}. See the privacy policy for the details.

terms.intro: The terms for using crierstudio.com, The Complete Kit, the monthly plans, the Brand Deck and the client portal.
terms.who.p: Crier Studio is not yet a registered company. Contact is by email only: {email}.
terms.offer.p1: The Complete Kit ({price:kit}, one-time, for one business): a complete marketing + brand-book PDF; a business review and {n:kit.competitor_profiles} competitor profiles; positioning, audience hypotheses and key messages; logo usage, colors, type and voice guidelines; {n:kit.posts} social designs with captions; {n:kit.campaign_concepts} campaign concept with {n:kit.ad_copies} ad-copy variations; the relevant standard brand mockups (up to {n:kit.mockups}); website/SEO priorities and a 30-day plan; and the individual creative files, with {n:kit.revision_rounds} correction round. It is built around your existing logo and approved assets.
terms.offer.p2: Brand Deck ({price:deck}, one-time): a brand deck made from your public pages, with your existing logo, showing up to {n:deck.products} of your products, delivered as digital files only: a screen PDF and a print-ready PDF file, with {n:deck.revision_rounds} correction round. Nothing physical is printed or shipped. There is no preview before you order.
terms.nopromise.p: We do not promise more customers, more sales, a search ranking or any other result. What we deliver is what is described on the pricing page. What happens next depends on your business, your market and what you do with it.
terms.need.p: Accurate details, and only photos, logos and text you have the right to use. Nothing is published for you: you decide what to use.
terms.public.p: We review your site and profiles and, for comparisons, public information about similar businesses. If we cannot find comparable businesses we say so. Numbers come from public sources and can be incomplete or out of date.
terms.own.h: Ownership of what we make for you
terms.own.p: The deck files, posts and captions we deliver to you are yours to use in your business. Your logo, name and brand stay yours. We do not show a Brand Deck made for you in public, as a sample or anywhere else, without your written OK. The samples on this site are made for fictional businesses.
terms.refund.p: If you are not happy with what we deliver, tell us and we will agree a fix or a refund with you in writing. See the refund policy.
terms.limits.p: We provide our services as described on this site. We do our best to be accurate, but public information we rely on can be incomplete or out of date, so check a deck or a post before you print or publish it. Questions about these terms: {email}.
privacy.intro: What Crier Studio collects when you order The Complete Kit, a monthly plan or a Brand Deck on crierstudio.com or use the client portal, why, who sees it, how long it is kept, and how to export or erase it.
privacy.collect.p1: When you fill in the form we collect what you type: your business name, your website or Instagram handle, your email address, your city and your industry. For a Brand Deck we also collect your business address and the language you want the deck in. We record the language of the page you used, that you ticked the box agreeing to the use below, and the time you did.
privacy.collect.p2: To limit abuse, the form's server briefly uses your connection's address to count requests. It is kept only as a scrambled value in memory for up to an hour and is not saved with your details. We do not use advertising cookies on this site. Analytics cookies are set only if you accept them (see Google Analytics and cookies below).
privacy.why.p: To prepare what you ordered, to run your client portal account if you have one, and to email you about what you asked for. We do not email you anything you did not ask for, and we do not sell your details.
privacy.who.p: Crier Studio (not yet a registered company) and the people who prepare its work. We use six service providers. Railway hosts the client portal and our records system. GitHub Pages hosts this site. Cloudflare handles the domain and, if we switch it on, Cloudflare Web Analytics, a visit counter that does not use cookies. Google (Google LLC) provides Google Analytics, described below. Proton handles our email. Stripe processes payments: you enter your card details on Stripe's own payment page, so we never see or store your full card number, and Stripe tells us your name, your email address, what you bought, the amount and whether the payment went through. The hosts and Cloudflare may see ordinary visit data such as the page viewed and the address of your connection. We do not share your details with anyone else unless the law requires it.
privacy.keep.p: We keep your form details for up to 12 months after our last contact with you, then delete them. Client portal data is kept while your account is open and until you ask us to erase it.
privacy.del.p: Email {email} from the address you used. You can ask us for a copy of the details we hold about you, ask us to correct them, or ask us to erase them. We will send the copy, or confirm the erasure, by email.
privacy.changes.p: If we change this policy, the date above will change. We will not use your details in a new way without asking you first.
refund.once.p: You pay in US dollars through a secure payment link we email you. Nothing is charged until you use that link.
refund.kit.p: The Complete Kit is a {price:kit} one-time payment. If you are not happy with what we deliver, email us within 7 days and we will agree a fix or a refund with you in writing.
refund.ask.p: Email {email} with the business name you used.

consent.label: Cookie choice
consent.text: We use Google Analytics to see which pages help. OK to set analytics cookies?
privacy.ga.p1: We use Google Analytics 4, a service of Google LLC, to see which pages of this site help visitors. It records the pages you visit and how you reached them, your approximate location (country and city, worked out from your connection's address) and your device, browser and screen size. Google Analytics 4 does not store your IP address. Google's advertising features are switched off, so this data is not used for ads. Google may process it in the United States and keeps it for the period set in our account, at most 14 months.
privacy.ga.p2: Google Analytics sets cookies only after you choose Accept in the cookie bar. Until you choose, or if you choose Decline, it sets no cookies; Google then receives only signals without cookies (for example, that a page was viewed) that carry no cookie identifier. Your choice is saved in your browser. To change it, use the Cookie settings link at the bottom of every page, or clear this site's data in your browser and the bar will ask again.
